For K=N=sum_x n_x, input psi=|+>_a|0>_elsewhere and one-qubit output, define E_T(H)=sup_{0<=t<=T} D(rho_H^a(t),rho_K^a(t)). A tolerant test accepts every E_T<=eta and rejects every E_T>=3/4 with probability >=2/3. A fresh sample supplies vacuum outside accessible ports S. Arbitrarily strong controls, ancillas, memory, measurements, resets and feedback are allowed only on S during total native time <=tau per sample. Splitting a coherent run does not reset this cap. Full-system terminal output and collective inter-run processing are granted; all discarded/postselected attempts count. No bath reinsertion, remote preparation or inverse unknown evolution is supplied. The Hamiltonian is fixed and memoryless across samples.

For d>=1 and 0<eta<=1/8, T=256d^2/eta^2, the source constructs two connected nearest-neighbour interacting chains on 2(d+1) qubits, all hoppings nonzero, bounded terms, positive density interactions and common unique vacuum ground state with gap>0.9. Reflection interchanges only the endpoint onsite coefficients and gives EXACT full-many-body isospectrality. The supplied alternatives differ by a single unknown assignment bit, yet E_T(Hg)<eta and E_T(Hb)>3/4. If both accessible arm prefixes end at r<d, R=d-r and 0<tau<=R/2, worst-case fresh experiment count N>=(2R+1)(R!)^2/[144 tau^(2R+1)]. For fixed eta,tau and r<=d/2 this is exp(Omega(sqrt(T) log T)). This is a lower bound, not matching minimax complexity. Expected total native duration averaged over the pair is >=(2R+1)(R!)^2/[144 tau^(2R)] when each run's duration is chosen at its start; arbitrary within-run stopping is outside that statement.

In the common ambient class, H conserves excitation, fixes vacuum and has one-excitation restriction I+C with ||C||<=2; zero hopping is allowed so exact-null models exist. Prepare psi, evolve h=min(tau,1/2)<=T, undo the candidate phase and measure X_a. For minus probability p, E_T<=min(1,(2T/h)sqrt(p)). No rejections in ceil[4T^2/(h^2 epsilon^2) log(1/alpha)] independent shots gives a sound epsilon certificate with exact completeness. It is not a tolerant-complete verifier. Reset and local operations cost N(C_reset+C_local), native time Nh; probability bias beta requires beta=O(h^2 epsilon^2/T^2) for this certificate.

Proof spine: alternating Lagrange weights on degree-2d Chebyshev-Lobatto nodes in [delta,1], delta=eta^2/(64d^2), yield positive spectral measures matching moments through 2d. The good measure has mass 1-rho at zero; the bad measure is supported >=delta with mass >=1-rho there, rho=tanh^2(2d artanh sqrt(delta))<=eta^2/9. Jacobi matrices differ only at the terminal diagonal. Reflection doubling, weak joining gamma=eta/(16T) and nonnegative density interactions make the connected isospectral pair. Target dynamics uses vacuum plus one excitation, not finite-density thermal hardness. For arbitrary active port controls the inaccessible endpoint occupation amplitude is <=2t^R/R! at t<=R/2. The overlap estimate ||I-Vg^dagger Vb||<=8u^(2R+1)/[(2R+1)(R!)^2] and adaptive quantum-memory composition give the count bound.

Matched dyadic rounding q<=min{eta/(96T),eta/(1200d^3)} preserves shared coefficients, positive hoppings, reflection and prediction margins with O(log(d/eta)) coefficient bits. The proof is an existence/precision statement; the numerical Jacobi compiler is not interval certified. The family is inhomogeneous with an inverse-polynomial weak link. Arbitrary independent bulk perturbations, fixed-noise robustness, Gibbs/finite-temperature preparation and decoherence are not covered. An additional endpoint |+> preparation and Y readout at t0=min(tau,1/32) distinguish the supplied pair in O(t0^-2 log(1/alpha)) shots; a coherent run of duration pi/delta also escapes. Neither escape is a universal Hamiltonian learner.

This continues N728 by changing the acquisition contract to active real-time local ports, without imaginary-time filtering. N728's logarithm/filter theorem and nominal Genesis bridge are not premises and remain intact. Existing local-operation learning/certification results have different spatial addressability, lifetime, preparation, norm or genericity assumptions; single readout alone is not excluded. Complete proof candidates and numerical diagnostics are preserved; independent correctness, historical priority, a practical positive tolerant certifier and technological advantage remain UNKNOWN.
